DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。自転車について、どのようなことがありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What happened with your bicycle?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 停めた電動自転車の電池がありません。車体は残っているので、車全体ではなく電池のことで相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 電動自転車の車体は残っているが電池がないと伝え、車体全体の盗難ではなく電池について相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: The battery is missing from the electric bicycle I parked. The bicycle itself is still there, so I would like to ask about the battery rather than the whole bicycle.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the electric bicycle itself is still there but its battery is missing, and ask about the battery rather than the theft of the entire bicycle. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 停めた場所と、電池を最後に確認した時を教えてください。外して保管したことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me where you parked it and when you last saw the battery. Have you removed it to store it somewhere?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨日この駐輪場所に置きました。家で充電したかもしれないので、家族に確認しています。盗まれたとまだ断定できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 昨日の駐輪場所を示し、家で充電した可能性を家族へ確認中なので盗難とは未確定だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I left it in this bicycle parking area yesterday. I may have charged it at home, so I am checking with my family. I cannot say yet that it was stolen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show where you parked yesterday and explain that theft has not been established because you are checking with your family whether you charged the battery at home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認できた事実を分けましょう。電池の特徴や番号がわかる資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us separate the facts you have confirmed. Do you have any documents showing the battery's features or number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 購入書類では、電池番号はB-204、車体番号はF-204です。数字は同じでも最初の文字と欄が違うので、混ぜずに見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 電池番号B-204と車体番号F-204は数字が同じでも別欄だと説明し、購入書類を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: The purchase documents show battery number B-204 and frame number F-204. The digits are the same, but the first letters and the fields are different, so I will show them without mixing them up.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that battery number B-204 and frame number F-204 have the same digits but appear in different fields, and show the purchase documents. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 書類を確認しました。電池欄にB-204、車体欄にF-204と分けて記録しました。家族から充電場所について返事が来たら、その内容も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I have checked the documents. I recorded B-204 in the battery field and F-204 in the frame field separately. When your family replies about the charging location, please tell us what they say too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 返事が来て、家の充電場所にはないそうです。車体の鍵はかけていましたが、電池の固定を確認したかは覚えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族から充電場所にはないと返事があったと伝え、車体の鍵はかけたが電池の固定は記憶が曖昧だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: They have replied and say it is not in the charging area at home. I locked the bicycle, but I do not remember whether I checked that the battery was secured.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that your family replied that the battery is not in the charging area, and explain that you locked the bicycle but are unsure whether you secured the battery. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 車体の鍵は施錠、電池の固定は記憶不明、家の充電場所にはないと家族から回答、ですね。電池B-204の相談として記録しますが、盗難かどうかはまだ断定していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: So the bicycle was locked, you do not remember whether the battery was secured, and your family says it is not in the charging area at home. I will record this as an inquiry about battery B-204, but theft has not yet been established.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その区別で合っています。見当たらないのはB-204の電池で、F-204の車体は残っています。家族の返答と固定の記憶不明も別々に記録してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 電池B-204がなく車体F-204は残るという読み返しを確認し、家族の返答と電池固定の記憶不明を別々に記録してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Those distinctions are correct. Battery B-204 is missing, while frame F-204 is still there. Please record my family's reply and my uncertain memory about securing the battery separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the readback that battery B-204 is missing while frame F-204 remains, and ask for your family's reply and your uncertain memory about securing the battery to be recorded separately. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当が状況を確認します。わからないことは未確認としてお伝えください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. The person in charge will check the circumstances. Please describe anything you do not know as unconfirmed. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。発送したお荷物について、何をご確認されたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to check about the parcels you sent?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 資料を二つの荷物に分けて送りました。この配達済みの画面を印刷して、会社に全部届いたと報告してよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 資料を二つの荷物で送ったため、一つの配達済み画面を使って会社に全体の到着を報告してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I sent documents in two separate parcels. May I print this delivered-status screen and report to my company that everything has arrived?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Since you sent the documents in two parcels, ask whether you may use one parcel's delivered-status screen to report to your company that the entire shipment arrived. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 二つのお荷物には、別々の番号が付いていますか。印刷した画面がどちらの番号か、差し出した時の控えと比べましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do the two parcels have separate tracking numbers? Let us compare the number on the printed screen with your shipping receipts.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 別々の番号です。印刷は一つ目の番号でした。二つ目はまだ見ていないのに、全部届いたと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二つには別の番号があり、印刷した画面は一つ目だけで、二つ目を確認せず全体が届いたと思っていたと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: They have separate numbers. The printout was for the first parcel. I thought everything had arrived even though I had not checked the second one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Correct your misunderstanding: the parcels have separate numbers, the printout covers only the first one, and you thought everything had arrived without checking the second. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、二つ目も確認しましょう。ここに出ている情報では、一つ目は今日十時に配達済み、二つ目は昨日十八時の輸送中の表示です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then let us check the second one too. The information here says the first was delivered at 10 a.m. today, while the second shows in transit as of 6 p.m. yesterday.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二つ目は昨日十八時の情報のままなんですね。今日届くはずだと思っていたので、もう配達されたと考えてよいか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二つ目は前日の輸送中表示のままで、今日の到着を予定していたため配達済みと考えてよいか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: So the second one's information is still from 6 p.m. yesterday. I expected it to arrive today, so I am unsure whether I can consider it delivered already.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm whether you may regard the second parcel as delivered because you expected it today, although its status still shows in transit from the previous day. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 予定と、今確認できる配達済みの情報は分けてください。この表示だけでは二つ目の配達完了を確認できません。必要であれば、二つ目の番号で担当へ状況を照会します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please distinguish the expected arrival from the delivery information currently confirmed. This display does not confirm delivery of the second parcel. If necessary, we can ask the person in charge about its status using the second tracking number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 会社への報告は、一つ目は今日十時に配達済み、二つ目は昨日十八時の輸送中の表示で、配達完了は未確認と分けます。照会するのは二つ目だけにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一つ目は本日十時に配達済み、二つ目は前日十八時の輸送中で配達完了は未確認と分けて報告し、二つ目だけの照会を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will report separately that the first was delivered at 10 a.m. today, and that the second shows in transit as of 6 p.m. yesterday with delivery still unconfirmed. I would like an inquiry about only the second one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report separately that the first parcel was delivered at 10 a.m. today and the second shows in transit as of 6 p.m. the previous day with delivery unconfirmed, and request an inquiry about only the second parcel. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。二つ目の番号と控えで照会します。追跡では荷物の配達状況を確認しますが、中の資料がそろっているかは受取先にも確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. We will inquire using the second parcel's number and receipt. Tracking checks the delivery status of the parcels, but please also ask the recipient whether all the documents inside are present.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 全部届いたという報告は送らず、二つの番号と確認時刻を分けて記録します。受取先には資料の内容を確かめてもらい、二つ目の状況が変わったら報告を更新します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 全体の配達完了とは報告せず、番号別の状況と確認時刻を残し、資料の内容を受取先に確認してもらい、二つ目の状況が変われば報告を更新すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not send a report saying everything arrived. I will record the two numbers and the times I checked separately. I will ask the recipient to check the documents inside and update my report if the second parcel's status changes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will not report the whole shipment as delivered; you will record each number's status and checking time, ask the recipient to check the documents, and update your report when the second parcel's status changes. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。二つ目の状況を担当へ確認します。照会の回答が出るまでは、配達完了とは記録しないでください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. We will ask the person in charge about the second parcel's status. Please do not record it as delivered until we receive a response to the inquiry. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。必要書類について、何をご確認しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to check about the required documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 申込みの書類を揃えたいです。本人確認のカードと、届いた通知の名字が違うので、どう示すか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本人確認カードと通知の名字が違うと説明し、申込みに必要な書類の示し方を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to gather the documents for my application. My identity card and the notice I received have different surnames, so I would like to ask how to present them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your identity card and notice have different surnames, and ask how to present the documents required for your application. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どちらが現在の正式な表記か確認します。変更の前後がわかる書類はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check which is your current official name. Do you have documents showing the name before and after the change?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: カードは新しい名前で、通知は前の名前です。家族の通知も持っていますが、それを私の証明として出すのではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: カードは新姓、通知は旧姓だと伝え、持参した家族の通知は自分の証明の代わりではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The card has my new name, and the notice has my previous name. I also brought a family member’s notice, but I am not presenting that as proof of my own identity.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that the card has your new surname and the notice your previous surname, and explain that the family member’s notice you brought is not a substitute for your own proof of identity. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご本人の新旧の情報を区別してください。担当が必要な書類と確認方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please distinguish your own old and new details. The person in charge will explain the required documents and how they will be checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 名字だけを手で直したコピーで済ませず、変更が確認できる資料を揃えたいです。原本が必要かも教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 氏名を手書きで直したコピーで済ませず、変更を示す資料を揃えたいと伝えて原本の要否も尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to gather documents that confirm the change rather than just use a copy with the surname corrected by hand. Please also tell me whether originals are required.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want documents showing the change rather than a copy with your name corrected by hand, and also ask whether originals are required. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 原本や写しの条件は、書類ごとに確認します。今のお住まいの記載も確認できていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check the conditions for originals and copies for each document. Have you also checked that your current address is shown?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 住所は今のものです。氏名の違いと住所の違いを混ぜず、今回違うのは名字と説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 住所は現在のものだと答え、今回は住所ではなく名字の違いだとはっきり説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: The address is current. I will not mix up a name difference with an address difference, and will explain that the difference this time is the surname.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Answer that the address is current, and clearly explain that the difference this time is the surname, not the address. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのように担当へお伝えください。追加で必要な資料があれば、確認してご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please explain that to the person in charge. If additional documents are needed, we will check and let you know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 本人の新旧名、変更資料、現住所のカードを分けて示します。家族の書類を代用せず、指定の原本や写しを用意します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人の新旧名と変更資料、現住所のカードを分け、家族の書類を代用せず指定の原本や写しを用意すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will present my own old and new names, the documents showing the change, and the card with my current address separately. I will not substitute my family member’s documents, and will prepare the specified originals or copies.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will distinguish your own old and new names, change documents, and card with your current address, and prepare the specified originals or copies without substituting a family member’s documents. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。必要書類を担当と確認しましょう。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Let us confirm the required documents with the person in charge. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。商品の比較で、何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. How can I help you compare the products?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この二つは袋の大きさが同じなのに、金額が違います。どちらも同じ量だと思って買ってよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 袋の大きさが同じなのに値段が違う二品を示し、同じ量として比べてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: These two bags are the same size, but their prices are different. May I buy them on the assumption that they contain the same amount?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show two products whose bags are the same size but prices differ, and ask whether you may compare them as containing the same amount. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 外袋ではなく、内容量の表示を確認しましょう。商品名と量を一緒に見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the stated contents rather than the outer bags. Please look at the product name and quantity together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 安いほうは少ない量でした。袋が大きくても中身が同じとは限りませんね。一袋の値段だけで比べないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 安い方の内容量が少ないと確認し、袋の大きさや一袋の値段だけでは比較しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The cheaper one contains less. Even a large bag does not necessarily contain the same amount. I will not compare them by the price per bag alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that the cheaper product contains less, and say you will not compare them only by bag size or the price per bag. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 表示された量と価格で比較できます。別の条件や付属品もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can compare the stated quantities and prices. Are there any other conditions or extras?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらにはおまけが付いています。おまけの量を本体に含めた数字なのか、別の表示なのかも確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: おまけ付きの商品を示し、その量が本体の表示に含まれるか別に示されているか確認したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: This one comes with a free extra. I would also like to check whether that extra quantity is included in the main product’s stated amount or listed separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the product with a free extra and say you want to check whether its quantity is included in the main product’s stated amount or shown separately. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それぞれの表示を分けて確認してください。必要な量と使い方に合うものをお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check each label separately. Choose something that suits the quantity you need and how you will use it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家族で使うのは少量なので、おまけが多いだけでは選びません。小さいほうの内容量と価格で決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族が使う量は少ないと伝え、おまけの多さではなく小さい商品の内容量と価格で選びたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: My family only uses a small amount, so I will not choose just because there is a large free extra. I would like to decide based on the smaller product’s contents and price.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say your family uses only a small amount, and you want to choose based on the smaller product’s contents and price rather than the size of the free extra. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 必要な量で選べます。会計では、選んだ商品と金額が一致するかも確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can choose the amount you need. At checkout, you can also check that the product you chose matches the price charged.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 袋の大きさ、本体の量、おまけを分けて見ます。必要な小さい量を選び、レジの金額を確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 袋、本体の量、おまけを区別して必要な量を選び、レジの金額も確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will look separately at the bag size, the main product’s quantity, and the free extra. I will choose the small amount I need and check the price at the register.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will distinguish the bag, the main product’s quantity, and the free extra, choose the quantity you need, and also check the register price. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。表示を確認してお選びいただき、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Thank you for checking the labels before choosing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。公園のご利用で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with using the park?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: スタンプラリーのカードを持ってきました。三つ押したのですが、二つが同じ色なので、まだ達成していないのか確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: スタンプを三つ押したカードを示し、二つの印が同じ色でも達成しているか確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I brought my stamp rally card. I have collected three stamps, but two are the same color, so I want to check whether I have completed it yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show your card with three stamps and say you want to check whether it is complete even though two stamps are the same color. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 参加案内では、池、花時計、広場の三か所の印を集める条件です。色だけでなく、印に書かれた場所の名前を一緒に読みましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The participation guide requires stamps from three places: the pond, flower clock, and plaza. Let us read the place names on the stamps together rather than just look at their colors.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 表には池と花時計があります。どちらも青です。同じ色でも名前は違うので、同じ場所の印が二つというわけではありませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 表の青い印は池と花時計で名前が違い、同じ場所の印が二つではないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: The front has the pond and flower clock. Both are blue. Even though they are the same color, the names differ, so they are not two stamps from the same place.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that the blue stamps on the front are the pond and flower clock, with different names, rather than two stamps from the same place. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、二か所の印です。広場の印はどこに押しましたか。カードを折っているので、裏の欄も見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, those are stamps from two places. Where did you put the plaza stamp? Since your card is folded, please look at the fields on the back too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 裏に広場の印がありました。折ったまま表だけ見ていました。三か所がそろったか、開いたカードで確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 折った裏面に広場の印があったと伝え、開いたカードで三か所がそろったか確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: The plaza stamp was on the back. I was only looking at the front while the card was folded. Please check the opened card to see whether I have all three places.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the plaza stamp was on the folded back side, and ask for the opened card to be checked for all three places. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 池、花時計、広場の三か所が確認できました。お名前の欄はまだ空いています。このカードはご本人が使ったものですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: I have confirmed the pond, flower clock, and plaza. The name field is still blank. Did you use this card yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、私が三か所を回りました。ここに自分の名前を書きます。友人のカードではなく、私のカードで受け取りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 三か所を回ったのは自分で、空欄へ自分の名前を書き、友人ではなく自分のカードで受け取りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, I went around all three places myself. I will write my own name here. I would like to receive the reward using my own card, not my friend’s.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you visited all three places yourself, will write your own name in the blank field, and want to receive the reward with your own card rather than a friend’s. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お名前も確認しました。こちらで達成の印を付けます。景色の絵葉書と鳥の絵葉書から、一枚をお選びいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: I have checked your name too. I will mark the card as complete here. You may choose one postcard, either a landscape or a bird.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 鳥の絵葉書を一枚お願いします。三か所の名前と達成の印を確認できたので、カードも記念に持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 鳥の絵葉書を一枚希望し、三か所の名前と達成の印を確認したカードも記念に持ち帰ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: One bird postcard, please. Now that the three place names and completion mark have been checked, I will take the card home as a souvenir too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request one bird postcard and say you will also take home as a souvenir the card whose three place names and completion mark have been checked. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらが鳥の絵葉書です。カードもどうぞ。ご参加ありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01222-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is your bird postcard. Here is your card too. Thank you for participating. Have a safe trip home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。列車のご利用について、何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with your train journey?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 根室からの旅行で、同行者と同じ列車に乗りたいです。二人の予定を一緒に確認してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同行者と同じ列車に乗りたいので、二人の旅行予定を一緒に確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to take the same train as my travel companion on a trip from Nemuro. Could you check both our plans together?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for both travel plans to be checked together because you want to take the same train as your companion. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お二人の予定の日付を見せてください。出発時刻だけでなく、日付もそろっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show me the dates in both your plans. Do the dates match as well as the departure times?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私の予定は土曜日ですが、同行者の画面は日曜日でした。同じ時刻なので同じ列車だと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分の予定は土曜日、同行者の画面は日曜日で、同じ時刻なので同じ列車だと思っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: My plan is for Saturday, but my companion’s screen showed Sunday. I thought it was the same train because the times were the same.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your plan is for Saturday and your companion’s screen shows Sunday, and that you thought it was the same train because the times matched. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 出発日が違いますね。同行者と相談して、どちらの日に合わせる予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: The departure dates differ. After discussing it with your companion, which day do you plan to choose?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 土曜日に合わせたいですが、同行者はまだ仕事の休みを確認していません。先に二人分を買うのは待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 土曜日に合わせたいが同行者の休みは未確定なので、二人分の切符はまだ買わないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: We would like to choose Saturday, but my companion has not confirmed their day off work yet. I will wait before buying tickets for both of us.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to choose Saturday but your companion’s day off is unconfirmed, so you will not buy both tickets yet. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、購入前に日程を決めましょう。決まったら、出発駅と到着駅も同じか確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then please settle the date before purchasing. Once it is decided, also check whether your departure and arrival stations match.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私は途中で降りる予定です。全区間が同じではないので、一緒に乗る区間と別れる駅を分けて伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分は途中で降りるため、一緒に乗る区間と別れる駅を分けて伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I plan to get off partway. We will not travel the entire route together, so I will distinguish the section we share from the station where we part.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Since you will get off partway, explain separately the section you will travel together and the station where you will part. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それなら、それぞれの行き先を確認してご案内できます。日程が確定したら改めてご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: In that case, we can check each person’s destination and advise you. Please consult us again once the date is confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 同行者の休みが決まってから、二人の出発日と一緒に乗る区間を持ってきます。今日は購入しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 同行者の休みが決まったら共通の出発日と区間を知らせ、今日は購入しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Once my companion’s day off is decided, I will bring both our departure dates and the section we will travel together. I will not buy tickets today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will provide the shared departure date and section once your companion’s day off is decided, and that you will not buy tickets today. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お二人の予定が決まったらお知らせください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please let us know once both your plans are settled. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。書類のご相談でしょうか。何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Would you like to discuss some documents? How can I help?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社へ住所の書類を出します。今の住所を書けばよいと思ったのですが、この指定を読んでもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会社に提出する住所の書類について、指定内容を読んで確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I need to give my company an address document. I thought I should write my current address, but could you read these requirements for me?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask someone to read and check the requirements for the address document you will submit to your company. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 指定には、いつの住所が必要と書かれていますか。ご自身は最近引っ越しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: What date’s address do the requirements ask for? Have you moved recently?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 月初め時点の住所とあります。私は月の途中に引っ越したので、その日は前の住所でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 必要なのは月初めの住所だが月の途中に転居したので、その時点では旧住所だったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says the address as of the beginning of the month. I moved in the middle of the month, so I was still at my old address on that date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the required address is the one at the beginning of the month, when you were still at your old address because you moved midmonth. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現在の住所と指定された時点の住所が違うのですね。提出先は、どの書類を指定していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: So your current address differs from your address at the specified time. Which document has the recipient requested?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 書類名は書かれていません。今の住所が載るものを取っても目的に合わないかもしれないので、会社に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 書類名は指定されておらず、現在住所の証明では目的に合わない可能性があるため、会社に確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: No document name is given. A document showing my current address might not serve the purpose, so I would like to check with my company.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say no specific document is named, and you want to check with your company because proof of your current address may not meet the purpose. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 提出先に、必要な時点と書類名を確かめてください。その後、こちらで扱う手続きか確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please ask the recipient to confirm the relevant date and the document name. We can then check whether the procedure is handled here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 会社には、引っ越した日と月初めの住所が違うことも伝えます。二つの住所を同じものとして書きません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 会社には転居日と月初めの住所を分けて伝え、二つの住所を同じものとして書かないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will also tell my company when I moved and that my address at the beginning of the month was different. I will not write the two addresses as though they were the same.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will distinguish your moving date and address at the beginning of the month when speaking to your company, and will not write the two addresses as the same. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。指定がわかったら、その内容と本人確認書類を用意してご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Once you know the requirements, please bring those details and identification documents to consult us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先に会社へ必要な書類と基準日を聞きます。今日は目的がわからないまま証明書を申請しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 会社に必要な書類と基準日を聞き、目的が不明なまま証明書を申請しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will first ask my company which document and reference date are required. I will not apply for a certificate today without knowing its purpose.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will ask your company about the required document and reference date, and will not apply for a certificate without knowing its purpose. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。確認できましたらまたご相談ください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please consult us again once you have confirmed the details. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。受付で何かお手伝いできることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Is there anything I can help you with at reception?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 問診票のこの欄を間違えたかもしれません。家族の病気を書く場所に、自分のことを書いてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 問診票の家族の病歴を書く欄に自分のことを書いたので、訂正について相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I may have filled in this part of the medical questionnaire incorrectly. I wrote about myself in the field for my family’s illnesses.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about correcting the medical questionnaire because you wrote about yourself in the family medical history field. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どこまで記入しましたか。訂正する箇所がわかるように、一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: How much have you filled in? Let us check together so we can identify what needs correcting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この一行です。自分が以前受けた治療を書きました。家族については、詳しく聞いたことがありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 間違えた一行を示し、自分の治療について書いたが家族の病歴は詳しく知らないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: This one line. I wrote about treatment I received in the past. I have never asked my family about their medical history in detail.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the incorrect line and explain that you wrote about your own treatment but do not know your family’s medical history in detail. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当に確認しました。この一行は「本人の治療歴」へ移せます。家族の欄は、病気がないと決めず、ご自身が確認できている範囲を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I checked with the person in charge. This line can be moved to your own treatment history. For the family field, please tell us what you have actually confirmed rather than assuming there are no illnesses.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家族に病気がないと書くのではなく、知らないと伝えたいです。自分の治療は別の欄に残したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家族に病気がないとは書かず未確認とし、自分の治療は別の欄に残したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I want to say that I do not know, rather than write that my family has no illnesses. I would like to keep my own treatment in a separate field.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to mark the family information as unconfirmed rather than no illnesses, and to keep your own treatment in a separate field. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その内容を担当に伝えます。以前の治療で、診療時に説明したいこともありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will tell the person in charge. Is there anything about your previous treatment that you would also like to explain during your consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 治療を受けた時期は覚えていますが、薬の名前は覚えていません。名前を想像して書かず、そのまま説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 治療を受けた時期は覚えているが薬名は不明なので、想像した名前を書かず説明すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I remember when I had the treatment, but not the medicine’s name. I will explain that as it is rather than write a name I have guessed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you remember when you received treatment but do not know the medicine’s name, and will explain that without writing a guessed name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 一行を本人の治療歴へ移し、薬名は不明、家族の情報は未確認と記録しました。自分の治療と家族の情報が別の欄になっているか、ご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I moved the line to your own treatment history and recorded the medicine’s name as unknown and the family information as unconfirmed. Please check that your treatment and family information are in separate fields.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、自分の治療は本人の欄へ移り、薬名は不明となっています。家族の欄も「なし」ではなく未確認ですね。わかる治療時期は担当に説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分の治療は本人欄で薬名不明、家族欄はなしでなく未確認という訂正を確認し、わかる治療時期を担当へ説明すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, my treatment has moved to my own field, and the medicine’s name is marked unknown. The family field says unconfirmed rather than none. I will explain the treatment timing I remember to the person in charge.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the correction: your treatment is in your own field with the medicine’s name unknown, and the family field says unconfirmed rather than none; say you will explain the treatment timing you know. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。記入を確認する担当へご案内します。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will direct you to the person who checks the form. Please take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなことでお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What seems to be the problem?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 帰宅したら玄関に傷がありました。誰かが入ろうとしたのか心配なので、相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 帰宅時に玄関の傷を見つけ、誰かが入ろうとしたのではないかと心配で相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I found a scratch by my front entrance when I got home. I am worried someone may have tried to get in, so I would like to ask for advice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you found a scratch by your front entrance on returning home and want advice because you are worried someone tried to enter. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今は安全な場所にいますか。誰かがいる気配や、なくなった物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are you in a safe place now? Is there any sign of someone there, or anything missing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私は外の明るい場所にいます。人の気配はありませんが、中の物はまだ確認していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 外の明るい場所にいて人の気配はないが、室内の物はまだ確認していないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am outside in a well-lit place. There is no sign of anyone, but I have not checked the belongings inside yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you are outside in a well-lit place with no sign of anyone, but have not checked the belongings indoors yet. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 不安なら無理に入らないでください。傷を以前見たことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: If you feel uneasy, please do not force yourself to enter. Have you seen the scratch before?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 入居した時の写真を見たら、同じ位置に傷が写っていました。今日できた傷とは言えなくなりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 入居時の写真にも同じ位置の傷があり、今日できた傷とは言えないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I checked a photo from when I moved in, and it shows a scratch in the same place. I can no longer say the scratch was made today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say a photo from when you moved in shows a scratch in the same place, so you cannot say it was made today. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その写真と今日見た状況を分けてお伝えください。ほかに変わったことは確認できていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please describe the photo separately from what you saw today. Have you confirmed any other changes?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 鍵が開いていたかは覚えていません。傷が古いことは確認できましたが、鍵の状態まで確かだったとは言いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 鍵が開いていたかは覚えておらず、傷が古いと確認できたことと鍵の状態は別だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I do not remember whether the door was unlocked. I have confirmed that the scratch is old, but I cannot say I was also certain about the lock’s condition.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you do not remember whether the door was unlocked, and that confirming the scratch is old is separate from the lock’s condition. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: わかりました。写真で確認できた点と、覚えていない点を担当に伝えます。現在の危険があればすぐお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I understand. I will tell the person in charge what the photo confirms and what you do not remember. Please let us know immediately if there is any current danger.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 古い写真にも傷があり、鍵の状態は不明、室内は未確認と説明します。入られたと決めつけず相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 古い写真の傷、記憶が不明な鍵の状態、未確認の室内を分け、侵入を断定せず相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will explain that the scratch is in the old photo too, the lock’s condition is unknown, and the interior is unchecked. I will seek advice without assuming someone entered.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish the scratch in the old photo, the lock’s condition you do not remember, and the unchecked interior, and say you will seek advice without concluding there was an intrusion. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。安全な場所で担当の案内をお待ちください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please wait in a safe place for instructions from the person in charge. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。発送について何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with shipping?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二つの荷物を別々の相手へ送りたいです。同じ送り状を二枚印刷してしまったので、貼る前に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 別の相手へ送る二箱に同じ送り状を二枚印刷したので、貼る前に確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to send two parcels to different people. I accidentally printed two copies of the same shipping label, so I want to check before attaching them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you printed two copies of the same label for two boxes going to different people and want to check before attaching them. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 送り状の宛先と、箱の中身はそれぞれ区別できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can you distinguish each label’s recipient and the contents of each box?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 宛先は両方とも兄になっています。もう一つは友人宛てです。箱は同じ見た目で、中身をどちらに入れたか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 送り状は両方とも兄宛てだが一箱は友人宛てで、同じ見た目の箱の中身も区別できていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Both labels are addressed to my older brother. The other parcel is for a friend. The boxes look the same, and I am not sure which contents I put in which box.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that both labels are for your older brother although one box is for a friend, and that you also cannot distinguish the contents of the identical-looking boxes. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 宛先だけ直しても、中身が違う可能性が残りますね。発送前に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Even if we correct the recipient, the contents might still be wrong. Let us check before shipping.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: いったん封を開けて、兄への服と友人への本を分けます。箱の大きさで中身を決めつけません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 箱の大きさで判断せず、封を開けて兄への服と友人への本を確かめると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will open them again and separate the clothes for my older brother from the books for my friend. I will not assume the contents from the box size.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will open the boxes to check the clothes for your older brother and books for your friend rather than judge by box size. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認したら、それぞれの箱と正しい宛先を対応させてください。印刷した古い送り状も区別しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Once you have checked, match each box to the correct recipient. Please also distinguish the old labels you printed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人の住所を新しく入力します。二枚ある兄宛ての送り状のうち、使わない一枚は貼らずに分けておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人の住所で新しい送り状を作り、使わない兄宛ての一枚は貼らずに分けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will enter my friend’s address anew. Of the two labels for my older brother, I will set aside the unused one without attaching it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will make a new label with your friend’s address and set aside the unused label for your older brother without attaching it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 再度封をしてから、箱ごとに宛先を確認できます。確認が終わるまでお預かりは待ちましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: After resealing the boxes, we can check the recipient for each one. Let us wait to accept them until you finish checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 服は兄、本は友人と確認してから封をします。一箱ずつ正しい送り状を見てもらって発送します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 服と本の相手を確認して封をし、一箱ずつ正しい送り状を照合してもらって発送すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will seal the boxes after confirming the clothes are for my older brother and the books for my friend. I will have you check the correct label against each box individually before sending them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will confirm the recipients of the clothes and books, seal the boxes, and have the correct label checked against each box before shipping. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。準備ができましたらお声がけください。ご利用ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please let us know when you are ready. Thank you for using our service.
